description.value:
You know the Mending cantrip.

As a Magic action while holding Tinker's Tools, you can create one item in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of yourself, choosing the item from the following list:

  • Ball Bearings
  • Basket
  • Bedroll
  • Bell
  • Blanket
  • Block and Tackle
  • Bottle, Glass
  • Bucket
  • Caltrops
  • Candle
  • Crowbar
  • Flask
  • Grappling Hook
  • Hunting Trap
  • Jug
  • Lamp
  • Manacles
  • Net
  • Oil
  • Paper
  • Parchment
  • Pole
  • Pouch
  • Rope
  • Sack
  • Shovel
  • Spikes, Iron
  • String
  • Tinderbox
  • Torch
  • Vial

The item lasts until you finish a Long Rest, at which point it vanishes.

You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

activation.condition: you must be holding Tinker's Tools
